title: Improving OneService App to Include Reporting of Vaping, Non-Singpass Verification and Automated Translation
what_it_is: Improving OneService App to Include Reporting of Vaping, Non-Singpass Verification and Automated Translation

sections.label: Vaping reporting channels expanded
sections.summary: HSA extended hotline hours and launched an online reporting form, with MOH and HSA exploring more ways to enhance vaping reporting channels.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Since July 2025, HSA has extended its hotline operating hours for reporting vaping related offences to seven days a week from 9.00 am to 9.00 pm.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: HSA has also launched an online reporting form to complement its hotline, as was answered earlier on with the preceding Parliamentary Questions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Where necessary, MOH and HSA will work with relevant agencies, including the Municipal Services Office (MSO), to explore other means to enhance the reach and accessibility of vaping reporting channels.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Separately, MSO's OneService municipal case reporting function is also available as an AI-enabled chatbot on WhatsApp, Telegram and Instagram messenger.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: These channels complement our OneService app and do not require Singpass authentication.
